spans.s:
Whiteness.
2

Cleanness, purity.
E.
विशद white, &c., and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-नः)
A sage, the original teacher of the Yajur Veda, and narrator of the Mahābhārata to JANAMEJAYA.

n. (-मं)
1 Hindrance, impediment.
2 Slaughter.

n. (-स्त्रं)
1 Government. sway, rule.
2 The state of being disarmed or defenceless.
E.
विशस्तृ ruling, अञ् aff., and the pen. vowel changed, or वि privative, शस्र a weapon, and अण् aff.

m. (-खः)
1 The month in which the moon is full near the southern scale, (April-May,) the first month in the Hindu calendar.
2 A churning stick.
n. (-खं)
An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart.
f. (-खी)
The day of full moon in the month Vaiśākha.
E.
विशाखा the constellation in which the moon is full this month, अण् aff. or विशाखा said to mean here, pervading, revolving, अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
Harlotry, allurement of harlots.
E.
वेश्या, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine.
n. (-कं)
The Vaiśeṣika doctrine, or branch of the Nyāya or logical school of philosophy, instituted by KAṆĀDA.
E.
विशष difference, (from the original Nyāya of GAUTAMA,) ठञ् aff.

n. (-ष्ट्यं)
1 Endowment with, possession of.
2 Distinction.
E.
विशिष्ट, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-ष्यं)
1 Specific or generic distinction.
2 Superiority, pre-eminence.
E.
विशेष, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-श्यः)
The Vaiśya, or man of the third or agricultural and mercantile tribe.
f. (-श्या)
A woman of the Vaiśya caste.
E.
विश to enter, (fields, &c.) क्विप् aff., and यञ pleonasm added.

f. (-या)
1 Trade, agriculture.
E.
वैश्य, and क्रिया act, business; also वैश्यकर्म्म, &c.

f. (-त्तिः)
Agriculture or trade.
E.
वैश्य, and वृत्ति subsistence.

m. (-णः)
KUVERA, the god of wealth.
E.
विश्रवस् the father of the deity, aff. अण्, and the form irr.

m. (-यः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
वैश्रवण KUVERA, and आलय abode.

m. (-सः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
वैश्रवण KUVERA, and आवास abode.

m. (-यः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
वैश्रवण KUVERA, and उदय prosperity.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
1 Sacred or dedicated to the Viśvadevas, offered to them, relating to them, &c.
2 Relating to all divinities.
n. (-वं)
Offering to all the divinities.
f. (-वी)
Species of the Paṅkti metre.
E.
विश्वदेव, and अण् aff.

n. (-र्म्मा)
Oblation or offering to the deities collectively.
E.
वैश्वदेव, and कर्म्मन् act.

n. (-मं)
Oblation to the Viśvadevas.
E.
वैश्वदेव, and होम burnt-offering.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Relating to, fit for, &c. all men.
m. (-रः)
AGNI or fire.
f. (-री)
A particular sacrifice to be performed at the beginning of every year.
E.
विश्वानर a Muni, or विश्व all, नर mankind, and अण् aff. of descent.

f. (-श्वी)
The second of the constellations called Āṣārhā, and twenty-first of the whole.
E.
विश्व a Viśvadeva, अण् and ङीष् aff.; those deities presiding over the asterism.

n. (-म्यं)
1 Inequality, unevenness.
2 Solitariness, singleness.
3 Difficult.
E.
विषम odd, uneven, &c., aff. ष्यञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A sensualist, one addicted to the pleasures of sense.
3 One occupied with worldly objects or interests.
E.
विषय an object of sense, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-तं)
The ashes of a burnt-offering.
E.
वि before स्तु to praise, aff. क्त, and अण् added.

n. (-ष्ट्रं)
A world.
E.
विश to enter, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Relating or belonging to VIṢṆU.
m. (-वः)
A follower of VIṢṆU.
f. (-वी)
1 One of the Mātṛs, the personified energy or Śakti of VIṢṆ
A name of

DURGĀ.
3

A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.)
4 Sacred basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
E.
विष्णु VIṢṆU, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-नः)
A fish.
E.
वि before सृ to go, णिनि aff., and अण् added.

n. (-नं)
A man's assuming female attire, (in the drama.)
E.
वि before सूच to make known, क्युच् aff., and अण added.
